more_beautiful.reason: B has the stronger hierarchy (a heavy slab-serif display over clean sans body), a warm cohesive cream/rust/slate palette and more finished cards, hero tag and form, while A's centred navy layout, modest type scale, sparse sections and plain default-looking form controls feel utilitarian.

less_generic.reason: A builds its whole identity on the repair-tag idea (tag logo, tag-shaped 'we can fix' labels, a typewriter-style date tag and a booking form that fills in your own repair tag) in an uncommon navy-and-kraft palette, whereas B, despite repair-specific copy, follows the stock AI landing-page formula (accent eyebrow plus two-tone headline, icon-chip feature cards, numbered 'How it works' steps, cream-and-terracotta palette) and even shows a visitor-facing template placeholder note.
